required_per_cycle.drive_id: nonempty drive identifier; changes require explicit reset boundary
required_per_cycle.drive_reset_boundary: boolean; a new drive starts with a reset and cycle clocks may restart only then
required_per_cycle.source_t_ns: per-service positive source monotonic timestamps no later than receipt
required_per_cycle.receipt_t_ns: per-service positive receiver timestamps no later than the cycle clock
required_per_cycle.driver_override: explicit boolean gas_pressed and brake_pressed observations
required_per_cycle.lead_history: source and receipt clocks for each model lead history entry; 200 ms maximum source age
required_per_cycle.carState: exact serialized C19 service fields with source and receipt timestamps
required_per_cycle.radarState: leadOne, leadTwo, radar errors, model alignment and source/receipt timestamps
required_per_cycle.modelV2: leadsV3 full trajectories, velocity, model timestamp and receipt
required_per_cycle.controlsState: cruise and engagement fields with source/receipt timestamps
required_per_cycle.vehicleParameters: pitch and vehicle parameters with source/receipt timestamps
required_per_cycle.carControl: longActive and driver override fields with source/receipt timestamps
required_per_cycle.CP: exact serialized CarParams and safety config, read only
required_per_cycle.planner_state: previous acceleration, profile, lead history, reset/drive boundary and all dynamic preferences
